title: LAX Near-Miss, a Cessna Flip at John Wayne, and American's Split Personality on First Class
summary: An Air France A350 and an American A321 come within 400 feet of each other over LAX, and a Cessna gets flipped by jet blast at John Wayne the same weekend. Plus, a Southwest flight attendant apparently quits mid-flight after a crew blowup, and American Airlines can't decide if it loves or hates first class.
